summary: Installed poker_ai CLI is broken on macOS: agent.py:8 runs mp.Manager() at import time, and bin/poker_ai imports cli outside its __main__ guard, so under spawn the child re-imports and dies with EOFError. Workaround recorded in REFERENCE_NOTES.md is python -c 'from poker_ai.cli.runner import cli; cli()'. A guarded launcher script would fix it properly.
